name: JEH Solar LLC
old_description: Lafayette, LA's premier solar power and electrical contractors with 30 Years of Experience. Serving all of Louisiana and parts of Texas.
about:
JEH Solar LLC is a solar and electrical contracting company based in Lafayette, Louisiana. Founded in 1996, the locally owned business has spent nearly three decades serving homeowners and businesses across South Louisiana and parts of Texas.

The company provides full‑service design, installation, and maintenance of solar power systems, electrical infrastructure, and backup generators. Its NABCEP‑certified team handles residential and commercial projects from engineering and permitting through commissioning, including off‑grid solar arrays, generator integration, electrical panel upgrades, and lighting work. The firm also offers project management and job‑site supervision on every install.

JEH Solar serves both residential and commercial customers. Residential clients rely on the company for rooftop solar, whole‑home backup power, and general electrical service. Commercial accounts include retail, industrial, and institutional facilities needing new construction wiring, solar arrays, and preventive maintenance. The company’s service area covers the Lafayette and Baton Rouge metros and surrounding parishes.

A stated differentiator is the firm’s national teaching role: its technicians travel the country instructing other contractors on solar installation and maintenance practices. Combined with NABCEP certification and a local ownership structure, the company positions itself as a turnkey energy contractor for the Gulf Coast region.
